problem_statement: Return a dictionary mapping each character in s to the number of times it appears. s is any Python string, including an empty string. For an empty string return an empty dictionary.
valid_input_domain: Return a dictionary mapping each character in s to the number of times it appears. s is any Python string, including an empty string. For an empty string return an empty dictionary.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution sets the count to 1 instead of incrementing when a character is already present, so repeated characters always show a count of 1.
